resources.string: Filters work only on this device. Matching incoming messages are hidden in the open chat and produce no notification. Nothing changes on the server, and unread counters and chat previews are not affected.
Test filters on a sample text

Local Premium only changes how this app looks and which features it unlocks on this device. Anything the server enforces (limits, Premium-only sending, stickers, reactions, translations, speech recognition) will not work. Hiding ads is also local.
